logDirectory.description: The VRChat log folder AntiBot follows.

language.description: Interface and backend language: system, en, ja, zh-CN or zh-TW.

oscPort.description: Port VRChat listens on for OSC.

startHidden.description: Start with the window hidden in the tray.

avatarApiProviders.description: Avatar-name lookup endpoints, tried in order.

autoBlock.description: Block a user whose threat reaches the threshold.

autoDisableAvatarInteraction.description: Turn avatar interactions off for a high-threat user.

autoHideChatBox.description: Hide a high-threat user's chat box.

autoCloseVrchat.description: Close VRChat when a high-threat user appears.

autoSafeMode.description: Turn VRChat's Safe Mode on over OSC.

autoSafeAvatar.description: Switch to the safe avatar over OSC.

safeAvatarId.description: Avatar to switch to; a favourite, recent or one of your own.

skipCloseInVr.description: Leave VRChat alone while a VR headset is in use.

autoRejectFriendRequests.description: Hide friend requests from high-threat users.

threatThreshold.description: 0-100; at or above this the automatic actions run.

whitelist.description: Users that are never acted on, whatever their score.
